section.question: The apply_discount method silently ignores expired coupon codes. What's the issue and how would you fix it?
section.snippet:
class Order
  def total_cents
    line_items.sum(&:price_cents)
  end

  def add_coupon(code)
    coupon = Coupon.find_by(code: code)
    @coupon = coupon if coupon
  end
end
section.teaching_note: Check what happens when add_coupon is called with an expired code.
section.scenario: a shopping cart applying a promo code
